module: Standing and falling water of a "site" (open space editor): waterfall basins, sheets that overflow between them, jets, sprays and foam jets (particle emitter BNGP_sprinkler). Water is not a mesh and therefore cannot be baked into a shell; the site manifest carries it as numbers and everything that assembles the site recreates the objects (WaterBlock, River, ParticleEmitterNode). Everything starts from a single record, expressed in the site's frame: an anchor point and an angle set the whole placement.
usage:
local sw = extensions.editor_toolUtilities_siteWater
local rec = sw.localise(ca, ox, oy, oz)      -- to the manifest
local ca2 = sw.place(rec, px, py, pz, yaw, ox, oy) -- from the manifest
local ids, names = sw.build(ca2, folder, 'site1')
notes: build() starts by calling remove(folder), so it rebuilds everything from scratch.
remove() sweeps by class (WaterBlock, River, ParticleEmitterNode) rather than by id list, because undo restores a document whose ids may refer to deleted objects.
A sheet (fall) starts from each of the 8 edges of a basin's rim (4 flat and 4 cut corners); the number of sprays is capped at 8 per edge.
The flow, sprayPow and sprayVar values are clamped to 0..1 in build; flow is 0.55 by default, sprayPow and sprayVar 0.5.
The altitudes (z, jetZ, spoutZ, zTop, zBot) are relative to oz/pz in the manifest and absolute in the editor record.

build.desc: Floods what the point of interest has placed (basins), then attaches a sheet to each face of each basin that overflows, with foam sprays, then the crowns (jets and weirs). Empties the folder first.

ca.desc: Editor record: pools, falls, crowns, flow, sprayPow, sprayVar, spraySeed.

folder.desc: Scene folder (SimGroup) that receives the objects.

tag.desc: Name of the site that assembles the water, so that two identical sites on a map do not have the same object names (default 'site').

returns.desc: Ids of the created objects (nil if no basins or no folder).

remove.desc: Removes everything wet under a folder: objects of the WaterBlock, River and ParticleEmitterNode classes.

folder.desc: Scene folder; no effect if nil.

commit.desc: Makes each object persistent (canSave and cansave set to true) and returns their names, which is used to undo a burn.

returns.desc: Names of the objects found and named.

localise.desc: Produces the manifest record, in the site's frame: only what build reads (basins, crowns, sheets, flow, sprays). Positions relative to (ox, oy, oz), basins and crowns relative to the anchor.

returns.desc: Manifest record, nil if there is no basin.

place.desc: Inverse operation: places a manifest record at a position and heading, ready for build. The anchor rotates around the placement and the angle is added to its own. (ox, oy) is the point of the site's frame around which the placement rotates (the middle of the footprint).

ox.desc: X of the pivot point in the site's frame (0 by default).

oy.desc: Y of the pivot point in the site's frame (0 by default).

returns.desc: World record, with ct and sn (cosine and sine of the heading); nil if rec is invalid.
